entities.name: Requested WUS assistance information
entities.description: Information element that the UE may include to request WUS assistance information if it supports WUS assistance and is not attaching for emergency bearer services.

entities.name: UE supports WUS assistance
entities.description: Condition that the UE supports WUS assistance functionality.

entities.name: Not attaching for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Condition that the UE is not performing an attach procedure for emergency bearer services.

relations.description: The inclusion of the Requested WUS assistance information IE is conditional upon the UE supporting WUS assistance.
